blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy wooden guard desk reinforced with dark iron corner brackets and studs. The front features two drawer faces and a mounted heraldic shield divided vertically into red and gold/yellow with an iron trim. On the desktop rest several distinct guard props: an open book with cream pages and a reddish binding, a dark steel helmet, a ring of iron keys, an iron lantern, and a carved wooden club/truncheon lying along the edge. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean geometry. The desk stands directly on four sturdy corner legs with metal footings resting flat on the ground. No hovering parts, floating flakes, or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden desk surface with dark metal corner brackets, featuring an open book in the middle, a dark dome helmet on the top left, a ring of keys on the bottom left, a wooden club along the bottom right edge, and a square-based lantern on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.8 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide across the front.
